summary: Completed full testing of License Request feature. Backend APIs (POST main-sites creates license_request, GET/PUT licenses/requests) all working. Frontend License Manager has 3 tabs with 'Requests' tab showing pending badge. SetupWizard displays license request step 'A license request has been sent to your license administrator.'
critical_code_review_comments: license_request.py: Well-structured service with proper async DB operations, sends email to clara.license@koodh.com
main_sites.py: asyncio.create_task(send_license_request(...)) correctly calls license request creation on site creation (lines 203-212)
licenses.py: GET /requests and PUT /requests/{id} endpoints properly implemented with network admin protection
LicenseManager.js: 3 tabs (License Overview, Requests, Packages) with badge showing pending count on Requests tab
SetupWizard.js: Step 8 shows license request notification text as specified
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST sites during testing (all cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: License Request feature fully implemented and tested. When a main site is created (any type), a license_request record is created in DB with status 'pending' and email is sent to clara.license@koodh.com. Network admin can view requests in License Manager > Requests tab and approve/deny them. SetupWizard shows step about license request being sent.
